original_text: In the hydro candidate location charts, the star (Kadri bearing crossing the run J mean impact line) is a geometric construction, not an estimate. It uses only the bearing and ignores the time difference, the bearing error and the shape of the impact PDF. A chart must label it as such and show the posterior mean and mode separately. The 'mean impact line' is run J D0' mean longitude per latitude, not the ridge of the 2-D PDF.
